description: This source file defines the GroupServiceModel class, which models a service within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides constructors for initialization from XML DOM elements or directly via service name and mode, accessor methods, and an invoke method to run the service through a dispatcher, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous invocations.

classes.name: GroupServiceModel
classes.description: Represents a grouped service in OFBiz, encapsulating its configuration, invocation mode, and execution logic.

methods.name: GroupServiceModel(Element service)
methods.description: Constructs the model from an XML DOM element representing the service, extracting attributes like name, mode, result-to-context, and parameters.

methods.name: GroupServiceModel(String serviceName, String serviceMode)
methods.description: Initializes the model with explicit service name and mode.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the invocation mode of the service (e.g., sync or async).

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service.

methods.name: resultToContext
methods.description: Indicates whether the service results should be placed into the context.

methods.name: isOptional
methods.description: Checks if the parameters are optional for this service.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Executes the service via the given dispatcher in either sync or async mode, handling validation and parameter processing.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the service model.
